section.catchline: Election to enter into an agreement.
section.subsection: A depository institution that does business in this state may elect to use the depository institution data match system to respond to judicial process against a delinquent taxpayer.
A depository institution may not make an election under Subsection (1) unless the commission approves the election.
A depository institution that elects to use the depository institution data match system shall enter into an agreement with the commission.

An election under this section does not preclude the commission from requiring a depository institution to respond to judicial process against a delinquent taxpayer:
by means other than the depository institution data match system; and as provided by law.
